scripts.build:light: node scripts/prepare-edition.mjs light && npm run tauri -- build --config src-tauri/tauri.light.conf.json
scripts.build:normal: node scripts/prepare-edition.mjs normal && npm run tauri -- build --config src-tauri/tauri.normal.conf.json --features embedded-core
scripts.android:init:light: npm run tauri -- android init --ci --config src-tauri/tauri.light.conf.json
scripts.build:android: npm run tauri -- android build --ci --debug --apk --target aarch64 --config src-tauri/tauri.light.conf.json
